story.summary: Enable agents to process HITL queue efficiently using keyboard shortcuts and filters. Shortcut help modal, filter dropdowns, persistent filter state, filtered count in header. [Source: 5-5-keyboard-shortcuts-filtering.md]

requirements.requirement: Keyboard shortcuts: A=Approve, R=Reject, E=Edit, N=Next, ←/→=Navigate, ?=Show shortcut help.
Filter UI: bot dropdown, date range picker, status dropdown; filter state persists in URL.
Filtered count shows in header; shortcut help modal displays all shortcuts.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Keyboard shortcuts for approve, reject, edit, next, navigation, help modal.
Filter UI with bot, date, status; persistent filter state in URL.
Filtered count in header; shortcut help modal displays all shortcuts.

structure.backend: API to list queue items with filters; support shortcut actions.
structure.frontend: Keyboard shortcut listeners, filter UI, shortcut help modal, persistent filter state, filtered count.
